name: Yuurei Yashiki no Nijuuyojikan
original_name: 幽霊屋敷の二十四時間
source:
It's a story about a group of three high school students who get lost in a haunted mansion in the middle of a dark forest while looking for their pet cat Miko. Inside the mansion disembodied spirits and curses await them!
The master of the mansion, the imprisoned spirit, Kanbara, is constantly watching them. While Kabara uses traps and evil spirits to drain them of their strength, will the three manage to join forces and escape the mansion?!
translation:
讲述了三名高中生在寻找宠物猫米子的过程中，在黑暗森林中的鬼屋中迷路的故事。豪宅内，无形的灵魂和诅咒正在等待着他们！
宅邸的主人、被囚禁的神原神原时刻注视着他们。当卡原用陷阱和邪灵耗尽他们的力量时，三人能否联手逃离宅邸？！
